ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising_edge timing to processes and sequences updates to registers such as rdata, addr_ff, mem_ram_b*, rden and bus_rsp_o.ack.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in mem_access and bus_feedback processes (process(clk_i) and process(rstn_i, clk_i))

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Active-low reset that forces registers to defined values in the reset branch; resets rden and bus_rsp_o.ack to '0' when asserted.
ports.evidence: process(rstn_i, clk_i) contains if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0'; bus_rsp_o.ack <= '0';

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Carries address, data and control fields used to derive internal addr, to write mem_ram_b* on writes, and to form rden and bus_rsp_o.ack responses.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i fields used in addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(...)), write conditions and rden/bus_rsp_o.ack assignments

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides address bits whose slice (addr_hi_c downto 2) is converted to internal addr used to index memories.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write data; its byte slices are written into mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 when writes are enabled.
ports.evidence: mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0); similar for other byte lanes

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Each bit gates the corresponding byte write into mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 when stb and rw are asserted.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.ben(0) = '1') then mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= ... (and similar for ben(1..3))

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates a valid bus request; with rw it gates writes, and with not rw it contributes to rden and bus_rsp_o.ack generation.
ports.evidence: Used in conditions: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ...; rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: High for write operations; combined with stb and ben to enable writes and inverted for read enable (rden) and ack generation.
ports.evidence: Conditions combine bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw for writes; rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Exports response fields (ack, data, err); ack is registered in bus_feedback, data is driven from rdata gated by rden, err is tied low.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack assigned in bus_feedback process; bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden='1') else (others=>'0'); bus_rsp_o.err <= '0'

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Registered ack driven from bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw inside the clocked bus_feedback process; reset forces it to '0'.
ports.evidence: In bus_feedback process: reset branch sets bus_rsp_o.ack <= '0'; on rising_edge(clk_i) bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) (or bus_req_i.stb when IMEM_INIT=false)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Held constant low; the err output is driven to '0' and exported.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Presents rdata on the bus when rden is '1', otherwise drives zeros; derived from internal rdata register.

signals.name: rdata
signals.functionality: Holds a 32-bit word read from memory arrays; updated from mem_ram_b* reads (and ROM in other generate branches) and supplies bus_rsp_o.data.
signals.evidence: rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)); rdata used by bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden='1') else ...

signals.name: rden
signals.functionality: Captured each clock from bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw and indicates when bus_rsp_o.data should present rdata.
signals.evidence: In bus_feedback process: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw); used in bus_rsp_o.data conditional

signals.name: addr
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived from bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2); used to index memory arrays and is captured into addr_ff.
signals.evidence: addr <= unsigned(bus_req_i.addr(addr_hi_c downto 2)); to_integer(addr) used to index mem_ram_b* and to capture into addr_ff

signals.name: addr_ff
signals.functionality: Captures addr on clock in alternative/generate configurations and is used as the index for memory reads presented on rdata.
signals.evidence: addr_ff <= addr inside rising_edge(clk_i) in mem_access generates; mem reads use to_integer(addr_ff) for rdata assignments

signals.name: mem_ram_b0
signals.functionality: Stores the low byte written from bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0) when stb and rw and ben(0) are asserted; its addressed element supplies rdata(7 downto 0) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0); rdata(7 downto 0) <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));

signals.name: mem_ram_b1
signals.functionality: Stores the second byte written from bus_req_i.data(15 downto 8) when enabled; supplies rdata(15 downto 8) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b1(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(15 downto 8); rdata(15 downto 8) <= mem_ram_b1(to_integer(addr));

signals.name: mem_ram_b2
signals.functionality: Stores the third byte written from bus_req_i.data(23 downto 16) when enabled; supplies rdata(23 downto 16) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b2(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(23 downto 16); rdata(23 downto 16) <= mem_ram_b2(to_integer(addr));

signals.name: mem_ram_b3
signals.functionality: Stores the top byte written from bus_req_i.data(31 downto 24) when enabled; supplies rdata(31 downto 24) on reads.
signals.evidence: mem_ram_b3(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(31 downto 24); rdata(31 downto 24) <= mem_ram_b3(to_integer(addr));
